name: app-shell
title: App shell: top bar + collapsible sidebar
description: Application layout: app.brain keeps the static top bar (brand, account link, skip link); views/_layout.brain wraps every view in a sidebar navigation that collapses behind a Menu button on narrow screens (Escape closes it), plus the session line. The links live in one list in views/_layout.brain.
notes: Add one entry to `links` in views/_layout.brain per new view, so every page stays linked. Components (<Sidebar>, <AppNav>) belong in views/_layout.brain, never in app.brain (B0132).
